newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank Qld in talks over Suncorp stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank Qld in talks over Suncorp stake.

text.p: The Bank of Queensland Ltd said on Thursday that it would hold talks with the Queensland state government about the future of Suncorp Insurance and Finance's 44 percent stake in the bank.

The follows the passing in the Queensland parliament of a bill facilitating a previously announced merger proposal between Suncorp, the Queenland Industry and Development Corporation (QIDC) and Metway Bank Ltd.

The merger plan follows a bidding battle in late June with St George Bank Ltd for Metway which was won by the Queensland government after it raised its offer to A$4.80 per share, topping St George's A$4.77 bid.

The bill includes an amendment which states that Suncorp or the merged entity cannot dispose of its Bank of Queensland stake without the prior approval of a general meeting of Bank of Queensland shareholders, at which meeting Suncorp or the merged entity would be ineligible to vote its shares.
Bank of Queensland said it was not currently in possession of any proposal to transfer the Suncorp holding to Metway.
By 10.45 a.m. (0045 GMT), Bank of Queensland shares were two cents higher at A$5.40 on light turnover of 5,856 shares.
Metway Bank shares were two cents lower at A$4.68 on thin turnover of 4,976 shares. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
